description: A six-row, sixteen-step drum sequencer whose rows can each be pushed ahead of or behind the beat

params.text: Switches this step's gate on or off for this row; the lamp in the button is lit while it is on
Pushes this row ahead of or behind the other rows by up to 15 of the 16 clocks that make a step
Sets how many steps the sequence runs before it starts again, 0 to 16
Sets the rate of the internal clock, one pulse every 0.08 seconds at the bottom of its travel down to one every 0.003 seconds at the top; it does nothing while a cable is in the external clock jack
Switches the gate outputs between Continuous, which holds 10V for as long as that step is the active one, and Trigger, which is a 1ms pulse of 10V as the step arrives

inputs.text: The clock the sequencer runs on; sixteen clocks move the sequence on one step, every change from 0V to any other voltage counts, and patching this jack takes the speed knob out of use
Any change from 0V to another voltage here puts every row back to its first step; clocks arriving in the moment after that are ignored

outputs.text: The gate of this row's active step, 10V or 0V; a 1ms pulse in Trigger mode and held for the whole step in Continuous mode
Passes on the clock the sequencer is running on: the external clock when one is patched, and otherwise the internal clock as a 1ms pulse of 10V

notes: the clock is divided by sixteen, which is what leaves room for a row to be moved by up to 15 clocks either way
the panel marks the clock jack ÷16 to show that division
every row is gates only; there is no CV row and no clock divider here
menu: Randomize all gates — turns every gate button on the panel on or off at random
Randomize Gates for row 1 — turns the gate buttons of the first row on or off at random
Randomize Gates for row 2 — turns the gate buttons of the second row on or off at random
Randomize Gates for row 3 — turns the gate buttons of the third row on or off at random
Randomize Gates for row 4 — turns the gate buttons of the fourth row on or off at random
Randomize Gates for row 5 — turns the gate buttons of the fifth row on or off at random
Randomize Gates for row 6 — turns the gate buttons of the sixth row on or off at random
Use DD cable color scheme - Light — replaces Rack's cable colour list with five colours of the maker's, after a confirmation step; the item ends in Dark under the Rack dark-panel setting

inputs.0:
high above 0V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads the internal clock.
inputs.1:
high above 0V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
